# E0137: the lineage's name is not an identifier

A lineage's name is an identifier: a letter followed by letters and digits. It
names the thing the schemas describe in generated code and in error messages,
so it must be usable as a name everywhere thema emits it.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship-v2"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0137]: the lineage's name is "ship-v2", which is not an identifier
 --> lineage.cue:1:7
  |
1 | name: "ship-v2"
  |       ^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = detail: name: invalid value "ship-v2" (out of bound =~"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$")
  = help: a name starts with a letter and continues with letters and digits
```
